name: v1.5.59
body:
### Bug Fixes

*   Enforce total non\-key columns size limit of 2000 MiB per table in issue 361

*   Fixes https://github/.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/cloud-spanner-emulator/issues/285.

*   Support default parameter values and SQL body in PostgreSQL UDFs.

*   fix clock drift reported in #389

*   Fix issue #387 - release memory after drop database


### New Feature

*   allow INSERT and DELETE on queue

*   Add support for expression indexes

*   Add support for PLACEMENTS and PLACEMENT_OPTIONS in INFORMATION_SCHEMA.

*   register queue TVFs in catalog

*   Support CREATE VECTOR INDEX with multiple key columns.

*   Expose Queues DDL.

*   register queue RENEWLEASE_TVF

*   Support setting per_placement_routing_metadata database option on Cloud Spanner Emulator.

*   add queues in information schema

*   Enable JSON comparison feature to Spanner Emulator

*   support long-running RECEIVE_ Queue TVF

*   release emulated spanner queue

*   Support DML on JSON subfields and subscripts in Spanner Emulator.
